purpose: Evaluate manipulation order, object lineage, measurement conditions and data honesty; no scientific backend is required
preset_rules: Fixtures may show non-paper trends and plausible faults; do not award procedural credit based on proximity to expected scientific conclusions
Calling a macro must not cause the environment to invent missing upstream assembly/acquisition events
Keep raw records separate for air, A/B, each hole/load and baseline/obstacle; do not relabel one as another
Waveform content and acquisition protocols are required future fixture inputs; this package has neither author waveforms nor purported completed acquisitions

derived_quantities.tube: Derive complex t and phase from complete two-load/four-position complex-pressure records; do not confuse names/units of |t| and |t|²
derived_quantities.pulse: Task-defined arrival-time differences; sample-speed calculations must explicitly account for replaced-air propagation time and geometric length, not treat extra delay as total transit time
derived_quantities.field: Pressure magnitude with coordinate masks; retain intensity separately as source processing terminology, without claiming real energy-flux intensity absent calibration/conversion

nonclaim: Similar obstacle/no-obstacle curves in preset scenes establish only preset-branch selection/data handling, not physical self-healing
